title: Condition
description: A binary state container applied/removed by effects from the shared effect registry. Each condition is an 'envelope' that a consuming effect (e.g. paralyze, poison) fills when applied to a target. Conditions do not define their own mechanics inline — they reference effect IDs that apply or remove them.

label.description: Human-readable name with spaces and capitalization.

description.description: What the condition is and what it does at a glance.

effects.description: Narrative/descriptive effects of this condition in each resolution mode.

video_game.description: Mechanical effect in video game/action-combat mode.

appliedBy.description: Effect IDs from the effects registry that can apply this condition.

removedBy.description: Effect IDs that can remove this condition (typically cure id 20 with appropriate parameter).

stacking.description: Whether multiple instances of this condition stack (e.g. exhaustion has 6 levels).

maxStacks.description: Maximum stack count if stacking is true.
